newsitem.title: USA: Durham, N.C., eyes reserves to offset trash costs.
newsitem.headline: Durham, N.C., eyes reserves to offset trash costs.

text.p: The finance committee for Durham, N.C.'s city council has proposed using reserve funds to offset rising costs associated with a new landfill, the News & Observer said Friday.

A judge recently ruled that the city cannot add a new landfill at a site adjacent to an existing dump. The council has appealed the ruling, but resulting delays have forced the city to use interim trash disposal methods that will increase its fiscal 1998 budget by $3 million to $189 million, the newspaper said.

The finance committee has proposed drawing the extra $3 million from reserve funds in order to avert a property tax increase. The $189 million proposal would raise spending by 7.6 percent over this year.
